capabilities: Create character or item sheets from forms with image, facts and badges
Define custom templates with fields, folders, file-name patterns and tags
Render infobox code blocks as floating cards beside the note text
Mirror sheet image and field values into note properties
Share templates between vaults as JSON
disambiguation: Not a wiki-publishing tool; it only renders an infobox code block as a floating card inside individual notes.
extras: Author states it is a work in progress with possible bugs, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Everything stays local: no network requests, no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show structured character, item or place sheets as wiki-like infoboxes inside a note.

relations.evidence: It's a sister plugin to Tell-A-Tale: Tell-A-Tale tells the story, Make-a-Wiki keeps its wiki
the image and any field can be mirrored into the note's properties, for Tell-A-Tale, Dataview

summary: Worldbuilding plugin that adds wiki-style infobox cards (picture, fact table, coloured badges) to notes, created and edited through forms and custom templates.
